description_en: Measure your prior knowledge before building the final project.

content.data:
Cara kerja sistem:
• DHT11 membaca suhu.
• Suhu mencapai batas atas → kipas ON lewat relay.
• Suhu turun melewati batas bawah → kipas OFF.
• OLED menampilkan suhu dan status kipas.

Penggunaan dua batas (histeresis) mencegah relay menyala-mati terus-menerus di sekitar satu nilai suhu.
content.data_en:
How the system works:
• The DHT11 reads the temperature.
• Temperature reaches the upper limit → fan ON via the relay.
• Temperature drops past the lower limit → fan OFF.
• The OLED displays the temperature and fan status.

Using two thresholds (hysteresis) prevents the relay from switching on and off continuously around a single temperature value.

content.data:
Alat dan bahan:
• Arduino Uno
• DHT11
• OLED I2C 128×64
• Modul relay 5 V
• Kipas DC kecil dengan catu terpisah
• Breadboard dan kabel jumper
content.data_en:
Tools and materials:
• Arduino Uno
• DHT11
• 128×64 I2C OLED
• 5 V relay module
• Small DC fan with a separate power supply
• Breadboard and jumper wires

title: Rangkaian Lengkap
description: Sambungan sisi kontrol dan sisi beban.

content.data:
Sisi kontrol (Arduino, 5 V):
• DHT11: VCC → 5V, DATA → D2, GND → GND
• OLED: VCC → 5V, GND → GND, SDA → A4, SCL → A5
• Modul relay: VCC → 5V, GND → GND, IN → D7 (active LOW)
content.data_en:
Control side (Arduino, 5 V):
• DHT11: VCC → 5V, DATA → D2, GND → GND
• OLED: VCC → 5V, GND → GND, SDA → A4, SCL → A5
• Relay module: VCC → 5V, GND → GND, IN → D7 (active LOW)

content.data:
Sisi beban (catu kipas terpisah):
• Catu kipas (+) → terminal COM relay
• Terminal NO relay → kipas (+)
• Kipas (−) → catu kipas (−), langsung tanpa relay

Relay memisahkan kedua sisi: sisi beban tidak terhubung ke Arduino sama sekali. Gunakan terminal NO (normally open) agar kipas mati saat relay tidak aktif atau Arduino kehilangan daya.
content.data_en:
Load side (separate fan power supply):
• Fan supply (+) → relay COM terminal
• Relay NO terminal → fan (+)
• Fan (−) → fan supply (−), directly without the relay

The relay isolates the two sides: the load side is not connected to the Arduino at all. Use the NO (normally open) terminal so the fan is off when the relay is inactive or the Arduino loses power.

title: Kode Program Kipas Otomatis
description: Sketch lengkap dengan histeresis dan tampilan OLED.

content.data:
Logika utama:
• t ≥ 30 °C → kipasNyala = true
• t ≤ 28 °C → kipasNyala = false
• Di antara 28–30 °C status tidak berubah (histeresis)
• Jika pembacaan gagal (isnan), status kipas dipertahankan dan OLED menampilkan Error
content.data_en:
Main logic:
• t ≥ 30 °C → kipasNyala = true
• t ≤ 28 °C → kipasNyala = false
• Between 28–30 °C the state does not change (hysteresis)
• If the reading fails (isnan), the fan state is kept and the OLED displays Error

description_en: A complete sketch with hysteresis and an OLED display.

title: Pengujian & Pengembangan
description: Skenario uji, analisis galat, dan ide pengembangan.

content.data:
Skenario pengujian:
1. Suhu < 28 °C → kipas OFF, OLED menampilkan suhu
2. Sensor dihangatkan ≥ 30 °C → kipas ON
3. Suhu turun ke 28–30 °C → kipas tetap ON (histeresis)
4. Suhu ≤ 28 °C → kipas OFF
5. Kabel DATA DHT11 dicabut → OLED menampilkan Error, status kipas tidak berubah
content.data_en:
Test scenarios:
1. Temperature < 28 °C → fan OFF, OLED displays the temperature
2. Sensor warmed to ≥ 30 °C → fan ON
3. Temperature falls to 28–30 °C → fan stays ON (hysteresis)
4. Temperature ≤ 28 °C → fan OFF
5. DHT11 DATA wire unplugged → OLED displays Error, fan state unchanged

content.data:
Analisis ketelitian sensor (bandingkan dengan termometer pembanding di beberapa titik suhu):
• Galat mutlak = |DHT11 − pembanding|
• Galat (%) = galat mutlak / pembanding × 100%
• Hitung rata-ratanya, bandingkan dengan akurasi pada datasheet.
• Catat juga waktu kipas menyala setelah suhu mencapai 30 °C untuk menilai kecepatan respons.
content.data_en:
Sensor accuracy analysis (compare with a reference thermometer at several temperature points):
• Absolute error = |DHT11 − reference|
• Error (%) = absolute error / reference × 100%
• Calculate the average and compare it with the accuracy in the datasheet.
• Also record the time it takes for the fan to turn on after the temperature reaches 30 °C to assess response speed.

content.data:
Ide pengembangan:
• Kendali kecepatan kipas dengan PWM dan driver motor
• Buzzer sebagai alarm suhu berlebih
• Log suhu ke kartu SD lewat SPI
content.data_en:
Development ideas:
• Fan speed control with PWM and a motor driver
• A buzzer as an over-temperature alarm
• Log temperature to an SD card via SPI
